name: 78220 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78220 (San Antonio) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78220 (San Antonio) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78220 (San Antonio) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
